addendum_2026_09_01.why: The 12 authored cases run 195-341 chars. Real ChatGPT traffic does not look like that: the agent expands a short user ask into an explicit layout spec, 800-2800 chars, naming cells, colours and merges. The corpus therefore never exercised the regime where generation latency actually lives — a 2751-char case logged output=14568 tokens and 134s, against a mean of 490 tokens and 7.5s across the authored cases. An effort sweep run only on the short cases showed almost no difference and would have been read as 'effort does not matter'.
